parameters.name: DataRegion
parameters.description: The region where the data lake resides.

parameters.name: SearchKey
parameters.description: The keyword that is used to search for catalogs.

parameters.name: Tid
parameters.description: The ID of the tenant. You can call the [GetUserActiveTenant](~~198073~~) or [ListUserTenants](~~198074~~) operation to query the ID of the tenant.

example.unifiedCli: aliyun dms-enterprise list-data-lake-catalog --data-region cn-hangzhou --search-key hive --tid 3 --workspace-id 120000 --region cn-hangzhou
